correctness.rationale: The continuous-time 4-site contact process with death rate 1 and birth rate lambda times infected neighbors has 15 transient states and exact backward matrix (|U|+lambda b(U))t_U-sum_deaths t_{U-v}-lambda sum_births counts*t_{U+w}=1. Independent Fraction Gaussian elimination at 24 distinct rates lambda=1,...,24 on both star and path confirmed each displayed rational Sc, Sl, Pi, Pe. Cramer's polynomial degree <=23 for each candidate cross-multiplied identity and 24 distinct roots establishes the rational formulas for ALL real lambda>0, not just sample interpolation. Difference signs are algebraic; Sl-Pi=lambda*Q(lambda)/(6*A*C) with Q(z)=108z^8+309z^7-1592z^6-9631z^5-21648z^4-26628z^3-19080z^2-7560z-1296; Q(5)<0,Q(6)>0 and one sign change implies unique positive zero rho~5.1709113956. Sc always top and Pe always bottom, with Pi>Sl for lambda<rho and reverse above; finite extinction mean follows transient finite CTMC absorption. No global conclusion for other sizes, rate heterogeneity or alternate dynamics.
